voices.profile: Voice: baritone, chest-resonant — full low-frequency body, sonically mid-40s, no effort or strain. Recording: dry close-mic studio; no reverb, no room — the voice sits inside the listener's head, not a physical space. Delivery: unhurried and deliberate, each word placed with intention; pauses held long enough to feel like gravity, not silence. Tone: solemn authority with quiet charge — not a man narrating events, but something larger than a man making itself known. Electrifying without volume. Inspiring without warmth.

Voice: warm mid-range male Hindi voice, sonically early 40s, conversational and unhurried — a person speaking to you, not an announcer selling at you. Recording: clean close-mic studio, lightly damped, minimal reverb, no broadcast sheen. Delivery: calm and even, short natural pauses between clauses, steady volume, no advertising lilt, no rising salesman cadence, no urgency. Tone: quietly certain and kind — the voice of someone stating something obvious that everyone has somehow accepted for years. Never loud, never excited, never comic, never sentimental.
